commentary: Market breadth score sits at 40 with a deterministic 'WEAK' gate, urging strict defensive discipline under O'Neil and Weinstein tenets. While headline indices rebounded on ADB growth revisions and crude softening below $100/bbl, internal participation remains fragile. Stan Weinstein's stage framework warns that rallies on thin breadth frequently succumb to distribution; Livermore similarly cautioned against heavy exposure when the general tide is unsupportive. Minervini's progressive exposure rules dictate restricting capital to reduced pilot allocations and demanding asymmetric setups. Only genuine Stage 2 candidates displaying pristine, accelerating CANSLIM earnings warrant engagement, while stocks with lagging or decelerating metrics must remain firmly capped at Watch status.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price holds above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 within 1.5% of its 104.09 pivot on 1.23× volume. MACD is positive, but lacking a tight multi-week VCP contraction.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction with Q1 FY27 revenue falling 56.3% YoY to ₹44.6 Cr and PAT dropping 25.5% to ₹1.02 Cr. Weak ROCE (5.6%) and low 3-year ROE (3.1%) fail CANSLIM standards.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Thesis invalidates below 95.68 stop. A high-volume breach of the 50-day SMA requires immediate exit; cut losses without hesitation.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Constructive Stage 2 advance above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Coiling within 1.5% of the 933.53 pivot with strong 2.31× volume expansion and healthy RSI 54.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Sharp turnaround in Q1 FY27 with revenue expanding 38.7% YoY to ₹536 Cr and net profit rising 53.8% (EPS ₹8.40). ROCE is 10.7% with manageable 0.36 debt-to-equity.
AARTIPHARM.risk: Invalidation occurs on a breakdown below 857.38 stop. Failure to clear pivot volume mandates strict loss discipline to preserve capital.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Clean Stage 2 uptrend positioned above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. Consolidating within 1.5% of 464.91 pivot on 1.37× volume; RSI 72 shows strong momentum.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Exceptional top-line momentum in Q1 FY27 as revenue jumped 67.8% YoY to ₹858 Cr and net profit rose 64.8% to ₹235 Cr (EPS ₹3.71). Heavy capital debt remains typical for utility renewables.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Thesis fails on a breach of 425.12 stop. Due to RSI 72, avoid chasing extended moves and cut risk at the 20-day line.

AEGISLOG.technical: High-conviction double-bottom breakout near 1501.70 entry trigger on robust 2.43× volume. Price rides rising 21/50/200 moving averages with bullish MACD and RSI 68.
AEGISLOG.fundamental: Exemplary CANSLIM fundamentals. Q1 FY27 EPS soared 269% to ₹13.80 on 38.2% sales growth. High ROCE of 27.6%, ROE of 22.9%, modest debt, and solid 18% FII sponsorship.
AEGISLOG.risk: Thesis invalidates below 1358.19 stop. A drop below base lows signals a failed breakout; exit quickly per Minervini risk controls.

AGI.technical: Cleared 20-day high at 824.82 on 2.0× volume expansion. Maintained above EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200 with RSI 60, but faces overhead supply from past congestion.
AGI.fundamental: Q1 FY27 PAT grew 11.8% to ₹99.4 Cr on 14.2% revenue growth (₹785 Cr), decelerating from Q4 FY26 (+19.4%). ROCE is 19.5% with low debt, but EPS growth misses CANSLIM's 25% threshold.
AGI.risk: Stop stands at 752.56. A close back beneath the 20-session breakout pivot negates the setup; execute disciplined stop-loss immediately.

AHCL.technical: Potent SEPA breakout to new 52-week highs, clearing 27.51 pivot on 1.78× average volume. Moving averages display textbook bullish fan, outperforming broad indices.
AHCL.fundamental: Q1 FY27 demonstrated rapid revenue scaling (+163% YoY to ₹87.6 Cr) and 87.6% net profit growth. ROCE is strong at 20.8%, debt has reduced, and promoters hold 70.3% unpledged.
AHCL.risk: Thesis fails on a drop below 23.93 stop. As an emerging small-cap, respect spread volatility and exit if trailing pivot fails.
